build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball above a hole between two angled bars
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with a specific angle and position in the PHYRE scene
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene at a specified height and horizontal position
update_task_relationship: update the task to require a ball to be placed inside a jar using spatial relationships
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata for the PHYRE task to PRE_TWO_BALLS level
